_note: mcp-scan is NOT defined here and stays agent-driven: it must be invoked once per directory that directly contains skill folders, and that discovery is not expressible in this schema (there is no {dirs:} placeholder). Aimed at a target root it exits 0 reporting nothing, so a naive lane entry would manufacture a clean result. jq and agentscan are fully mechanical and belong here.
